Step 3. Consider the equivalent operator \(T_{1470013}\) acting on the complete space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the equivalent-complete decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1470013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1470013}\).
